checks.reported_value: OK: neuronunit.capabilities, neuronunit.tests.passive, neuronunit.tests.waveform. SyntaxError: tests, tests.fi, tests.dynamics, tests.druckmann2013, tests.channel. ImportError (TemporaryDirectory missing from sciunit.utils 0.2.8): models, models.backends, models.lems. Deps: sciunit 0.2.8, efel 5.7.34, pyneuroml 1.3.22, neo 0.14.5, elephant 1.2.1, numpy 2.5.3, numba 0.67.0, scikit-learn 1.9.1

corrections_summary: Most factual claims hold: versions, dates, licenses, requires_python, CI matrix, commit and release history, issue numbers, bibliographic records and API/class names were independently re-derived and match. No claim was outright fabricated. Corrections: (1) sciunit 'usable on Python 3.12' needs a qualifier. TestSuite without an explicit name raises TypeError on 3.12 (suites.py random.randint(0, 1e12); open issue #218 since 2023-09-05, unfixed on master). The report's smoke test only passed because it named the suite. (2) neuronunit dev: tests.passive and tests.waveform do NOT import in a fresh interpreter (tests/__init__.py imports the broken fi.py). The report's OK result was an import-order artefact. (3) The blanket 'NeuronUnit does not import / jNeuroML adapter does not import on Python 3.12' is scoped wrongly. The prime branch (newest activity, 2021-07-18) imports tests, models, lems and the jNeuroML backend on 3.12 with sciunit 0.2.8. Only target_spike_current is broken there. It is still unreleased, has no LICENSE, and pins legacy deps. (4) 'No efel usage found' is wrong for the repository as a whole: dev imports efel in optimization/optimization_management.py and unit_test scripts. (5) Open-issue counts include PRs: sciunit 22 issues + 2 PRs (not 24 issues); neuronunit 61 issues + 1 PR (not 62). (6) 0.1.8.2 ReducedModel and ChannelModel are in models/reduced.py and models/channel.py, not models/__init__.py. (7) Windows MAX_PATH breaks more than debugpy: jedi (and lxml in a slightly longer path) also fail; the clean short-path install could not be re-verified under the mandated scratch path. Precision notes: the PyPI 0.2.8 sdist is not identical to the GitHub v0.2.8 tag (tag pins importlib-metadata<4.0), and merge-conflict markers on dev affect 12 files, not just requirements.txt and fi.py. The recommendations (do not depend on NeuronUnit; SciUnit at most an optional adapter) remain reasonable, and the unnamed-TestSuite bug strengthens the case against a core SciUnit dependency.
additional_findings: sciunit 0.2.8 Python 3.12 incompatibility: TestSuite(tests) without name= raises TypeError because suites.py line 43 calls random.randint(0, 1e12); reproduced on CPython 3.12.10. Open issue #218 'Python3.12: two tests fail' (2023-09-05) documents it; the line is unchanged on master; PR #226 removes it. https://github.com/scidash/sciunit/issues/218 ; https://github.com/scidash/sciunit/blob/master/sciunit/suites.py
sciunit issue #211 'Test failure on Py3.11' is open (created 2022-07-01, last updated 2023-08-06). https://github.com/scidash/sciunit/issues/211

PyPI sciunit-0.2.8 sdist differs from the GitHub v0.2.8 tag: the tag's setup.cfg pins importlib-metadata<4.0, while the sdist (uploaded 2024-01-03, after PR #223 merged 2023-12-26) leaves it unconstrained; package code under sciunit/ is identical. Issue #224 'SciUnit 0.2.8 missing on PyPi' (opened 2024-01-02, closed 2024-01-03) explains the gap. https://github.com/scidash/sciunit/issues/224 ; https://pypi.org/pypi/sciunit/json

sciunit PR #226 (apdavison, open, unmerged) moves metadata to pyproject.toml with version 0.3.0.dev.0 and requires-python >=3.9. It sets the CI matrix to 3.9, 3.10, 3.11, 3.12, 3.13, 3.14 with fail-fast false and bumps actions/checkout v4 and setup-python v5. Its 'Python package' workflow run on 2026-02-19 concluded success. A future sciunit release may therefore drop 3.7/3.8. https://github.com/scidash/sciunit/pull/226

Windows long-path limits hit several sciunit transitive dependencies: debugpy (via ipykernel) and jedi (via ipython) failed in the mandated scratch venv, and lxml 6.1.3 failed in a venv whose name was 3 characters longer. Importing and using sciunit worked without debugpy and jedi. NeuroSem setup docs should require short paths, LongPathsEnabled, or Linux/Docker. https://pip.pypa.io/warnings/enable-long-paths

neuronunit prime branch (last commit 7fd648c754, 2021-07-18, 'Bug fixes; reorganize notebook docs') imports on CPython 3.12.10 with sciunit 0.2.8 and modern deps: neuronunit.tests (22 classes incl. RheobaseTest, FITest, TFRTypeTest, ISICVTest, LocalVariationTest), tests.druckmann2013, tests.channel, neuronunit.models, models.lems, models.backends.jNeuroML. tests.target_spike_current still has merge markers. Its backend registry is jNeuroML + eden (eden_simulator optional; no jithub). lems.py uses tempfile.TemporaryDirectory. setup.cfg install_requires: allensdk==0.16.3, efel, elephant==0.4.1, lxml==4.4.1, neo==0.5.2, pyneuroml, sciunit, tqdm==4.48.2 (no git+ssh). https://github.com/scidash/neuronunit/tree/prime

The sciunit.utils.TemporaryDirectory incompatibility was fixed upstream in neuronunit PR #261 (merged 2021-04-22) but into the metacell branch, not dev; master and prime use tempfile.TemporaryDirectory. https://github.com/scidash/neuronunit/pull/261

neuronunit dev has unresolved merge-conflict markers in 12 files, not just 2: requirements.txt, tests/fi.py, tests/target_spike_current.py, models/very_reduced_sans_lems.py, optimization/algorithms.py, optimization/optimization_management.py, and unit_test/__init__.py, adexp_opt.py, izhi_opt.py, model_tests.py, opt_ephys_properties.py, scores_unit_test.py. https://github.com/scidash/neuronunit/tree/dev

neuronunit dev models/__init__.py wraps the LEMSModel/ChannelModel imports in a bare except that prints 'neuroml not installed', which masks the real ImportError (TemporaryDirectory). https://github.com/scidash/neuronunit/blob/dev/neuronunit/models/__init__.py

NeuronUnit uses efel only in its optimisation / Allen-data code: 'import efel' in neuronunit/optimization/optimization_management.py and unit_test/adexp_opt.py, izhi_opt.py; efel_filter_iterable parameters in allenapi/allen_data_driven.py and allen_data_efel_features_opt.py. Relevant prior art for eFEL-based model fitting in the novelty matrix. https://github.com/scidash/neuronunit/blob/dev/neuronunit/optimization/optimization_management.py

pyNeuroML 1.3.22 bundles the jNeuroML jar (pyneuroml/lib/jNeuroML-0.14.0-jar-with-dependencies.jar; JNEUROML_VERSION '0.14.0') and launches it through a 'java -Xmx<max_memory> ... -jar' shell command in runners.py. A NeuroSem jNeuroML pilot therefore needs only a Java runtime, not a separate jNeuroML install. run_lems_with_jneuroml defaults: max_memory '400M', load_saved_data False, exec_in_dir '.', exit_on_fail True. https://pypi.org/project/pyNeuroML/1.3.22/

neuronunit backends/base.py detects NEURON/PyNN with os.system("python -c 'import neuron' > /dev/null 2>&1"). On Windows this prints 'The system cannot find the path specified.' (observed when importing the prime backends), a small POSIX-only portability defect (present on both dev and prime, base.py lines 26-27 on prime). https://github.com/scidash/neuronunit/blob/prime/neuronunit/models/backends/base.py

neuronunit 0.1.8.2 sdist setup.py also carries dependency_links to git+http://github.com/neuralensemble/python-neo.git#egg=neo-0.4.0dev (ignored by modern pip) and ships no LICENSE file. https://pypi.org/project/neuronunit/0.1.8.2/
